changelog:
- Initial release of agent101-tool-directory.
- Provides open access to 500+ tools, APIs, and services for AI agents.
- Supports category-based HTTP GET requests, returning structured metadata for each tool.
- Includes details like auth requirements, free tier, supported actions, example calls, and usage guidance.
- No authentication required; regularly updated and protocol-agnostic.
summary: Open directory of 500+ tools, APIs, and services for AI agents. Fetch any category page to get structured tool metadata with auth, free_tier, actions, input/...
